source: Curated 2026-04-17 from lexicons/v1/rst/elaboration.json. Single-word discourse adverbs that are genuine elaboration cues in technical and analytical prose but fire as conversational fillers in dialogue and journalistic registers (e.g. 'Indeed, she said.', 'Precisely.', 'Notably.'). The compact and extended scanners apply a sentence-length guard (>=8 words) when checking these cues so they do not fire on dialogue tags and short declarative fillers. Cues kept in elaboration.json fire without the guard.
